headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty extended gains for the third straight week supported by strong FII inflows.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: FPIs infused ₹84,290 crore into Indian equities during the first fortnight of November.
Smallcap indices surged 3.6% while PSU Bank stocks rallied 7.5% over the trading week.
Sustained buying by foreign institutional investors offset global market concerns.
Market sentiment was bolstered by rotation trades out of global AI tech stocks into Indian equities.
whatHappening: SEBI announced plans to issue AI usage guidelines for capital markets to strengthen investor protection.
Mahanagar Gas increased CNG prices in Mumbai by ₹1.5/kg, marking its sixth revision since May.
Escorts Kubota announced plans for a new manufacturing facility in Uttar Pradesh with a capacity of 60,000 tractors.
Zomato's parent company Eternal revised its 2030 EV delivery targets amid fleet expansion.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices posted their third consecutive week of gains, driven by substantial foreign portfolio investment inflowing into domestic equities.
Strong momentum in PSU banking and smallcap stocks supported the market momentum despite intra-week volatility.
Key stock actions featured manufacturing capacity expansion by Escorts Kubota and CNG price revisions by Mahanagar Gas.
